message: <div role="option"> stands under <ng-content> with no role and a global ARIA attribute (`aria-label`)
$reason: An `<ng-content>` under `ngNonBindable`, between the reference's listbox and an option, with a name on it. Under `ngNonBindable` it is no projection: the tree holds it as an element, and `ngc` (22.2.1) draws it as one with its attribute (`ɵɵdomElementStart(2, "ng-content", 1)`, `["aria-label", "Elsewhere"]`), so it is in the accessibility tree and the listbox may not own the option through it. Counted among Angular's own tags by its name, it was looked through and the option passed. A projection is no element of the walk at all, so the name no longer has a projection to stand for.
